quantifier_audit.classical_maier: for fixed v,w the congruences y=0 mod P1P3 and y=1 mod P2 determine exactly one residue modulo P(x)
quantifier_audit.sono_fmt: a residue vector (a_p mod p) determines exactly one m modulo P by CRT
quantifier_audit.important_difference: FMT proves existence of suitable vectors through randomized construction, so a family exists before the existential output is frozen; however its published numerical package does not include the weighted prime-error correlation or a common finite failure budget
quantifier_audit.forbidden_inference: an average over unrelated y or over an unspecified family cannot be assigned to the one CRT shift used by the sieve construction
